subject: Zaffer pilot: data residency & compliance checks / contract exceptions
messages:
From: Tom Redding <tom@zaffer.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 16:12:00 +0100
Subject: Quick: pilot terms + data residency questions

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team liked Redwood’s latency and routing features. We’re interested in a 6-month pilot for our EU customers (medical devices distribution) but have a few non-negotiables before we can move forward:

- All customer data must remain in EU jurisdiction and not be routable to the US.
- We need confirmation on export control screening and sanctions checks — please share results or process.
- We will request a 35% pilot discount and a short-term indemnity carve-out for device-safety claims.

I’ve attached our procurement/KYC packet for your review (see procurement@zaffer.com). Can we get an initial readiness/eligibility note + any required contract excpetions?

Best,
Tom Redding
Head of Ops, Zaffer, Inc

Attachment: zaffer_kyc_packet.pdf (application/pdf, 1.2MB)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Tom Redding <tom@zaffer.com>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick: pilot terms + data residency questions

Tom — thanks for the clear summary and for sending the packet. I’ve looped in Legal (David) and Security (Vivek) to validate eligibility.

Next steps on our side:
1) We’ll run sanctions/export screening and KYC checks on Zaffer (Vivek).
2) Legal will review requested contract exceptions and the indemnity language (David).
3) I’ll pull a pilot pricing proposal and confirm what we can do on data residency (private VPC vs hosted EU).

Can you send over the expected start date and an approximate ARR projection for the pilot group? That will help us size Dedicated/private options.

I’ll aim to get a first-read from internal teams by EOD Thursday.

—Kimberly
Enterprise Account Exec, Redwood Inference

> From: Tom Redding <tom@zaffer.com>

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick: pilot terms + data residency questions

Kimberly — I reviewed the KYC packet and the procurement notes. High-level legal flags:

- Data residency: We can offer a Private EU deployment (VPC) for the pilot, but this will require a Limited MSA amendment to reflect data location, audit rights, and processor/subprocessor list.
- Indemnity/Carve-outs: Zaffer’s proposed device-safety carve-out is non-standard. We can consider a narrow indemnity carve limited to claims arising from Zaffer’s integration/configuration, but not product liability tied to Zaffer devices.
- Discount and term: 35% for 6 months is outside standard pilot allowances. Approval required from Deal Desk/Revenue Ops. Please provide business justification and pilot ARR estimate.
- Export control warranty: We need Zaffer to represent they are not on any sanctions or export-restricted lists and to provide supporting evidence. If there is any match, we require an export-control exception evaluation.

I’ve attached a redline template with the clauses I expect us to negotiate. Please route for deal desk + security clearance prior to accepting exceptions.

-David
Sr. Counsel, Redwood Inference

Attachment: redlined_msa_zaffer_v1.docx (document/x-docx)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 15:18:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Quick: pilot terms + data residency questions — security assessment

Team — I ran initial security and sanctions screens against Zaffer using our Marketplace vendor tools. Findings:

- Sanctions watchlist: one low-confidence name overlap flagged in sanctions database (see attached CSV). Not a direct match to ultimate beneficial owner, but requires secondary verification from Zaffer (beneficial ownership docs).
- Industry: Zaffer operates in the medical distribution space (regulated). For EU-hosted private deployments we recommend:
  - Customer-managed Private (VPC) in EU region only.
  - Network egress restrictions to prevent traffic to non-EU regions.
  - Contract clause requiring customer to notify us of any regulatory escalation.

Risk posture: conditional approval for pilot if Zaffer provides beneficial-ownership attestation and we get a clean sanctions resolution (or formal risk acceptance by Risk Committee). I’ve attached a short security assessment explaining recommended mitigations.

-Vivek
Head of Trust & Safety, Redwood Inference

Attachments: sanctions_search_results.csv (text/csv), security_assessment_zaffer.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 09:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick: pilot terms + data residency questions — Deal Desk position

Kim — after reviewing the packet and Legal/Security notes, Deal Desk position:

- Pilot discount: can approve up to 25% for a 6-month pilot (not 35%) given medical-distribution vertical risk.
- Deployment: must be Private EU-only with RBAC and egress controls as Vivek recommended.
- Contract exceptions: we will accept a narrowly-tailored indemnity for integration errors only (David’s proposed language). Any further carve-outs require Exec Risk sign-off.
- Sanctions/Export: We require a clean secondary verification on beneficial ownership within 72 hours. If that cannot be provided, deal is paused.

If Kimberly can secure Zaffer’s attestation and projected pilot ARR > $75k, we will fast-track a signed amendment and apply the 25% credit retroactive to the pilot start date.

-Laura
Head of Deal Desk, Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Tom Redding <tom@zaffer.com>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Quick: pilot terms + data residency questions — next steps

Tom — thanks for your patience. Summary / Redwood position:

1) Eligibility: We can run the 6-month pilot with an EU-only Private deployment, subject to completion of the KYC/beneficial-ownership attestation and a secondary sanctions screening. Please upload the requested documents to the Drive link below.
2) Pricing: We can offer a 25% pilot credit (not 35%) conditional on pilot ARR >= $75k.
3) Contract: Legal proposes a narrow indemnity carve (integration-related incidents only). We’ll send a redlined amendment for signature once KYC/clearance is done.
4) Security controls: Private VPC + egress lock to EU, RBAC, and audit logging will be in place for the pilot.

Next actions for Zaffer:
- Provide beneficial ownership attestation and a scanned government ID for the majority owner.
- Confirm pilot start date (target week of 07/12).
- Confirm willingness to accept the limited indemnity language.

I’ll follow up with the redline and the Drive upload link. If you can get the attestation by EOD Monday we’ll aim to spin up a private pilot by mid-July.

Drive upload: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/zaffer/kyc-packet

Thanks — looking forward to moving quickly.

—Kimberly
Enterprise Account Exec, Redwood Inference
